quotes.quote: And meanwhile time goes about its immemorial work of making everyone look and feel like shit.
quotes.author: Martin Amis,  London Fields

quotes.quote: It's paradoxical that the idea of living a long life appeals to everyone, but the idea of getting old doesn't appeal to anyone.
quotes.author: Andy Rooney

quotes.quote: Sometimes I get depressed about my age. In March I'll be 26. If man weren't measured in numbers, but rather letters, I'd be turning Z. And then I'd be dead.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  I Should Have Renamed This

quotes.quote: I had a dream about you. The seasons changed, but you did not. You were the same old person you always were, only older. And I was the same old person I always was, only younger. Yes, I'd discovered the Fountain of Youth, and since we were such old friends, I was going to let you have a swig for 10% off the suggested retail price.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  We Had A #Dream About You

quotes.quote: I was tired of seeing the Graces always depicted as beautiful young things. I think wisdom comes with age and life and pain. And knowing what matters.
quotes.author: Louise Penny,  A Fatal Grace

quotes.quote: Clutching to your fading youth is like trying to hang on to a handful of smoke. Just breathe deeply and you'll be OK.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: The trick to looking ageless is drinking 55 gallons of #FlashBangWowFuzz every 4-6 hours. 24-hour discounts available.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Now, five years is nothing in a man's life except when he is very young and very old...- Wang Lung
quotes.author: Pearl S. Buck,  The Good Earth

quotes.quote: With age comes wisdom, but sometimes age comes alone.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Middle age is when you're sitting at home on a Saturday night and the telephone rings and you hope it isn't for you.
quotes.author: Ogden Nash

quotes.quote: I was seen spotted with an older woman and a girl half my height in age. A leopard was also spotted.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

quotes.quote: I'm older now than my dad was when he was my age. Wait, that's not right. That's not my dad at all, that's just some stranger hanging around in my memory.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the best book I've ever written, and it still sucks

quotes.quote: Old men tend to forget what thought was like in their youth; they forget the quickness of the mental jump, the daring of the youthful intuition, the agility of the fresh insight. They become accustomed to the more plodding varieties of reason, and because this is more than made up by the accumulation of experience, old men think themselves wiser than the young.
quotes.author: Isaac Asimov,  Pebble in the Sky

quotes.quote: Later on in life, you expect a bit of rest, don't you? You think you deserve it. I did, anyway. But then you begin to understand that the reward of merit is not life's business.
quotes.author: Julian Barnes,  The Sense of an Ending

quotes.quote: I have nothing now but praise for my life. I'm not unhappy. I cry a lot because I miss people. They die and I can't stop them. They leave me and I love them more...
quotes.author: Maurice Sendak

quotes.quote: Thank goodness for the first snow, it was a reminder--no matter how old you became and how much you'd seen, things could still be new if you were willing to believe they still mattered.
quotes.author: Candace Bushnell,  Lipstick Jungle

quotes.quote: I'm 30-years-old, and I still can't get out from under my father's shadow. He's really tall, so maybe I'll just ask him to move over a few feet.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  The Titanic would never have sunk if it were made out of a sink.

quotes.quote: I believe that maturity is not an outgrowing, but a growing up: that an adult is not a dead child, but a child who survived. I believe that all the best faculties of a mature human being exist in the child. . . . that one of the most deeply human, and humane, of these faculties is the power of imagination.
quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin,  The Language of the Night: Essays on Fantasy and Science Fiction

quotes.quote: It was a bitter moment for us. We weren't two mature parents. We were just two kids playing grown-up. We still needed Mommy and Daddy's permission, blessings, and money to survive.
quotes.author: Erma Bombeck

quotes.quote: Grown people know that they do not always know the way of things, and even if they think they know, they do not know where and how they got the proof.
quotes.author: Zora Neale Hurston,  Dust Tracks on a Road

quotes.quote: In the age of technology there is constant access to vast amounts of information. The basket overflows; people get overwhelmed; the eye of the storm is not so much what goes on in the world, it is the confusion of how to think, feel, digest, and react to what goes on.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

quotes.quote: Tous mes anciens amours vont me revenir.'- All my old loves will be returned to me
quotes.author: Carolyn Turgeon,  Godmother: The Secret Cinderella Story

quotes.quote: If you're not getting happier as you get older, then you're fuckin' up
quotes.author: Ani DiFranco

quotes.quote: Stuart Hall was an utterly unique figure. Although he arrived at the age of 19 from Jamaica and spent the rest of his life here, he never felt at home in Britain. This juxtaposition was a crucial source of his strength and originality. Because of his colour and origin, he saw the country differently - not as a native, but as an outsider.
quotes.author: Martin Jacques

quotes.quote: One thought I think every person eventually thinks is, 'Holy shit, I'm going to die!' Sorry, I just turned thirty yesterday, so my mortality is on my mind.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

quotes.quote: The first door in the hall leads to youth, the second door leads to middle age, and the third door leads to the bathroom. But knock first, because I think grandpa's in there.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

quotes.quote: I told Ella Mae Cheeks Johnson, then age 105, that she was the only person over 80 who I'd ever met who never referred to her physical infirmities or health problems. To which she replied, "I have my difficulties; I do not rejoice in them.
quotes.author: Patricia Mulcahy,  It Is Well with My Soul: The Extraordinary Life of a 106-Year-Old Woman

quotes.quote: For us lads of eighteen they ought to have been mediators and guides to the world of maturity, the world of work, of duty, of culture, of progress -- to the future.
quotes.author: Erich Maria Remarque,  All Quiet on the Western Front

quotes.quote: People talk to old people like they're children.'Oh you're very old aren't you?' Yeah I'm old. I'm not stupid.
quotes.author: Craig Ferguson

quotes.quote: I don't see,' I said, 'how people stand being old. Your insides all dry up. When you're young you're so self-reliant. You don't even need much religion.
quotes.author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

quotes.quote: Hardest of all, as one becomes older, is to accept that sapient remarks can be drawn from the most unwelcome or seemingly improbable sources, and that the apparently more trustworthy sources can lead one astray.
quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens,  Hitch-22: A Memoir

quotes.quote: In a general sense, I admit to valuing the worldviews of men under the age of 40 and women over the age of 30.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: I have been in my bed for five weeks, oppressed with weakness and other infirmities from which my age, seventy four years, permits me not to hope release. Added to this (proh dolor! [O misery!]) the sight of my right eye -- that eye whose labors (dare I say it) have had such glorious results -- is for ever lost. That of the left, which was and is imperfect, is rendered null by continual weeping.
quotes.author: Galileo Galilei,  Lettere di Galileo Galilei

quotes.quote: A young child is a leader to an elderly person once his purpose has a faithful, sincere and trustworthy influence on people. Leadership is not restricted to position and age; it is self-made and influencial. Everyone has this self-leadership quality.
quotes.author: Israelmore Ayivor

quotes.quote: THE FOUR HEAVENLY FOUNTAINSLaugh, I tell youAnd you will turn backThe hands of time.Smile, I tell youAnd you will reflectThe face of the divine.Sing, I tell youAnd all the angels will sing with you!Cry, I tell youAnd the reflections found in your pool of tears -Will remind you of the lessons of today and yesterdayTo guide you through the fears of tomorrow.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: He had an answer to almost everything and he retired at an early age.
quotes.author: Dejan Stojanovic

quotes.quote: when you live forever and don't age, it gives you time to hope
quotes.author: Laurell K. Hamilton

quotes.quote: Sorry. I get attacks of quotitis every once in a while. It's a very rare disease with no cure. It usually attacks older people, and here i am afflicted with it at my tender age.
quotes.author: Madeleine L'Engle,  The Joys of Love

quotes.quote: Nat: Maybe you broke something.Midge: I know. Never fall down, never fall down!Nat: Ah, it's nothing. I fall down every morning. I get up, I have a cup of coffee, I fall down. That's the system. Two years old, you stand up and then BOOM! seventy years later, you fall down again.
quotes.author: Herb Gardner,  I'm Not Rappaport

quotes.quote: We are no longer in the dispensation of age and experience. We are in the era of knowledge and information. Information leads a true leader and a true leader leads others.
quotes.author: Israelmore Ayivor

quotes.quote: Though why should we expect age to mellow us? If it isn't life's business to reward merit, why should it be life's business to give us warm, comfortable feelings towards its end? What possible evolutionary purpose could nostalgia serve?
quotes.author: Julian Barnes,  The Sense of an Ending

quotes.quote: In the digital age of 'overnight' success stories such as Facebook, the hard slog is easily overlooked.
quotes.author: James Dyson

quotes.quote: Result of HARDWORK Is Neither Friends Nor Enemy,To the AGE Of the ACHIEVER!
quotes.author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

quotes.quote: You are never too old to start over. Every day is a chance to make changes to create the life we want.
quotes.author: Karon Waddell

quotes.quote: We can live forever even with an impactful shorter-life.
quotes.author: Aniekee Tochukwu Ezekiel,  Psychology of Friendship for Leadership

quotes.quote: Create your own path.Don't blindly follow the massess... because most of the time the "M"is silent.
quotes.author: Abhishek Shukla,  The Reflection "Success or Stress"Choose Wisely

quotes.quote: Your friends can be double-edged knife thy can either nurture you or destroy you. Choose them Wisely......
quotes.author: Abhishek Shukla,  The Reflection "Success or Stress"Choose Wisely
